fragmentedArguments.requiredName: assembles fragmented arguments, journals normalized input, and continues after a tool

interleavedParallelArguments.requiredName: assembles character-streamed arguments for interleaved parallel tool calls

adjacentReadConcurrency.requiredName: runs adjacent reads concurrently while preserving write barriers and result order

crossRuntimeWriteSerialization.requiredName: serializes writes across concurrent runtime instances

omittedToolRepairLease.requiredName: leases an omitted installed tool into the next iteration for one repair attempt

invalidArgumentsRepairLease.requiredName: leases a schema-invalid tool until corrected arguments execute successfully

trueUnknownFailClosed.requiredName: does not lease a truly unknown hallucinated tool

executableAliasNormalization.requiredName: normalizes an executable legacy dispatcher alias before validation and execution

builtInDefinitionLease.requiredName: binds built-in execution to the exact definition leased for the turn

durableDuplicateReplay.requiredName: persists one authorized effect and replays duplicates without mutation or post-write review

postCompactionToolContinuity.requiredName: keeps the selected tool executable on the iteration after verified compaction

danglingTopologyFailClosed.requiredName: fails closed on dangling canonical tool topology before any compactor runs

boundaries.liveProviderNetworkCall: not required; provider conformance belongs to milestone I
boundaries.nativeUiSmoke: not required; native acceptance belongs to milestone J
boundaries.retries: one-iteration schema repair lease; repeated identical all-failed rounds still force honest synthesis
boundaries.taskBudgets: no tool-round or task-token ceiling was added by this milestone
